raw.rationale: Chlorprothixene is a dopamine receptor antagonist with broad off-target activity (muscarinic, histamine, serotonin), and at 2.5 µM for 5 days it is likely to cause non-selective cytotoxicity across most lineages; PRISM screens of similar neuroleptics show few, if any, lineage-selective kills, with any selectivity most plausibly in CNS or neuroendocrine lineages. Thus probabilities are near the low base rate for all lineages, slightly elevated for central_nervous_system and lung where dopamine/GPCR dependencies or transporter expression might marginally increase sensitivity.
